method: Separate whole-process DHAT and Callgrind profiles of the exact timed Relar and Rust binaries in the recorded linkage mode. Every process handles 64 KiB of raw data using repeated codec calls, including startup, checksum and file I/O. Full output, checksum, sources, inputs, binaries, records, profiling tools and retained artifacts are verified before/after execution.
instruction_measurement: Instrumented Callgrind guest instruction counts (Ir), not CPU cycles, CPU time, or wall-time performance. Inclusive and exclusive annotations are retained separately.
allocation_measurement: DHAT requested heap bytes/blocks over the whole process, including runtime and I/O allocations; not RSS. Global peak uses gb/gbk contributions, not independent allocation-point maxima. Exit-live totals alone are not a leak diagnosis.
